purpose: Counterfactual frozen rerun of the checkpoint-ready control after the named prompt-composition hypothesis: remove the duplicated outer GOAL wrapper from R/C inputs without changing ContinuationState, RGR, fixtures, models, or prefix controls.

hypothesis.causal: The legacy R/C path passes a prompt already rendered with GOAL: through a renderer that adds GOAL: again; the resulting duplicated wrapper may reduce next-action fidelity.
hypothesis.counterfactual: R/C receive the same durable prompt body with exactly one renderer-owned GOAL wrapper; U and all other control inputs are unchanged.
hypothesis.invalidation: No improvement in complete triplets or no replication outside the concentrated Sonnet/tests failures invalidates this as a general Cairn correction.

supersedes.reason: Newly authorized counterfactual; v0.6 remains immutable baseline evidence.

qualification.qualified_pair: U, R, and C each verify successfully in one complete record
qualification.scope: checkpoint-ready reference control; counterfactual prompt composition only

holdout.first_use: only after v0.7 gate passes, counterfactual analysis, and before publishing any contract
